name: EPIC 212706255
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 9.5 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212706255 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.516745 (16th-84th percentiles 9.119776-9.954119), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,574 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.88 solar masses and 9.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,040 K at its surface.
